methods.label: Use the exponent-sum law
methods.explanation:
Increasing the exponent of \(4\) by \(1\) multiplies its value by \(4\). Thus, for every real \(x\),
\[
f(x+1)=4^{x+1}=4\cdot4^x=4f(x).
\]
Subtracting \(f(x)\) gives
\[
f(x+1)-f(x)=4f(x)-f(x)=\boxed{3f(x)}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
